questions.question: King Cyrus decreed that certain things Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem must be returned. What were they?
Which two prophets spoke God's message while the Jewish elders rebuilt the temple in Jerusalem and prospered?
At the dedication of the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem, Israel offered twelve male goats as a sin offering. Why twelve?

answers.text: One for each tribe of Israel
One for each month of the year
One for each gate of Jerusalem

questions.question: When the exiles who returned to Jerusalem kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days, where did their joy come from?

answers.text: Their neighbors made peace with them
